description: Ask to publish a reviewed DRAFT. This doesn't publish by itself: Whiteflow creates an approval request for this exact version (total, currency, customer), and an Owner of the business approves it on the review page; then the invoice gets its number and payment URL. A conversation 'yes' is not that approval. The connector re-checks the totals first and refuses if they don't add up. Nothing is emailed or sent.

idempotency_key.description: Optional, advanced: your own key for this exact request. Leave it out normally: a retry of an unresolved request is resumed automatically.

invoice.description: The invoice id (inv_…) or its number (WF-1042).

name: finalize_invoice
title: Request invoice publication
